title: 第1章 穿书炮灰，但有系统
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
“太虚宗招生大典即将开始，请宿主立即赶往指定地点，完成相应装逼任务。任务奖励：神级修炼功法《太荒混沌诀》一本。”

    呃？太虚宗招生大典，这是给她干到哪来了？

    微生璃月脑子有些迷糊，她记得自己前一秒还在跟卡在嗓子里那颗高科技鱼丸做斗争，下一秒就突然来到这里。

    还有一道莫名其妙的声音给自己颁布任务，她该不会像小说里写的那样，因为被鱼丸噎死然后赶上穿越大潮了吧！

    似乎是感受到微生璃月内心的想法，装逼系统适时出声：“恭喜宿主认清自己的情况，你现在就是穿到了一本小说里了哦，本世界剧情已下发至宿主识海！”

    系统声音贱兮兮的，仿佛还带着点幸灾乐祸。

    一刻钟后，接收完世界剧情后的微生璃月发出悲鸣：穿书就成不了主角就算了，怎么她还穿成了里面的炮灰女配，甚至连反派都算不上。

    人家反派要么天资卓绝，要么家世显赫，前期那是牛逼轰轰的存在。

    而她在原剧情里的身份，前期一点福没享就算了，身份还是个从小父母双亡、孤苦无依的小可怜。

    在宗门里修炼资质中等，好不容易靠着自己辛苦努力修炼到金丹期，却因为一次秘境试炼，自己跟龙傲天男主的某位红颜知己选择方向有分歧，就被两人记恨上，害死在秘境当中。

    这草蛋的人生，草蛋的剧情，她运气怎么这么差。

    前世天天在公司加班当牛马，好不容易犒劳自己点了一份豪华版麻辣烫当夜宵，结果还被里头的高科技鱼丸噎死。

    现在穿书了，身份又是出场没几次的炮灰工具人。

    微生璃月觉得，这个世界大概没有几个人比她更惨了。

    “宿主你别嚎了，怪难看的。还有，你是不是忘记了自己还绑定着系统，你看看我的名字——装逼系统。

    一看就知道不是那些让宿主攻略男人卑微受气的低级系统，我们俩在这个世界的任务，就是到处装逼，闪瞎那些修士的眼睛。”

    “原剧情里龙傲天男主到处扮猪吃虎装逼打脸？不，现在我们来了，我们一人一统才是装逼打脸界最豪横的神。
content_en:
"The Taixu Sect's enrollment ceremony is about to begin. Please rush to the designated location immediately and complete the corresponding pretentious tasks. Task reward: a copy of the god-level cultivation technique "Taihuang Chaos Jue"."

Huh?Taixu Sect Admissions Ceremony, where did she come from?

Weisheng Liyue was a little confused. She remembered that one second she was fighting against the high-tech fish ball stuck in her throat, and the next second she suddenly came here.

There was also an inexplicable voice that issued a mission to herself. Could it be that she choked to death on fish balls and caught up with the tide of time traveling like in the novel?

As if sensing Weisheng Liyue's inner thoughts, the pretense system spoke out at the right time: "Congratulations to the host for recognizing his situation. You have now traveled through a novel. The plot of this world has been sent to the host's sea of consciousness!"

The sound of the system is cheesy, as if it is a bit schadenfreude.

A quarter of an hour later, after receiving the story of the world, Liyue, a micro-student, wailed: Even if she can't become the protagonist if she wears the book, how come she still wears the cannon fodder female supporting role in the book, and she can't even be considered a villain.

The villains are either extremely talented or have prominent family backgrounds. In the early days, they were awesome and powerful.

As for her identity in the original plot, even if she didn't enjoy any blessings in the early stage, her identity is still a poor and helpless little girl whose parents died when she was young.

His cultivation qualifications in the sect were average, and he had finally reached the golden elixir stage through hard work. However, because of a trial in a secret realm, he and a certain confidante of the male protagonist Long Aotian had different choices of direction, so they hated him and killed him in the secret realm.

This Cao Dan's life, Cao Dan's plot, why is she so unlucky?

In my previous life, I worked overtime every day in the company as a cow horse. I finally rewarded myself by ordering a deluxe version of Malatang as a late night snack. In the end, I choked to death on the high-tech fish balls inside.

Now that he has passed through the book, his identity is that of a cannon fodder who has only appeared a few times.

Weisheng Liyue felt that there were probably few people in this world who were worse off than her.

"Host, please stop howling, it's so ugly. Also, have you forgotten that you are still bound to the system? Look at my name - Pretending System.

At first glance, you can tell that it is not one of those low-level systems that make the host attack men humble and suffer. The mission of the two of us in this world is to show off everywhere and blind the eyes of those monks."

"In the original plot, the male protagonist Long Aotian goes around pretending to be pigs, eating tigers, and getting slapped in the face? No, now we are here, and together we are the most arrogant god in the world of pretending to be slapped in the face.
title_en: Chapter 1: Cannon fodder through books, but with a system
